The is a department in Heaven responsible for the governing of water, as well as supervising the operations of regional Dragon Kings. It is led by the Water Star.

page.overview:
Who is Department of Water?

The is a department in Heaven responsible for the governing of water, as well as supervising the operations of regional Dragon Kings. It is led by the Water Star.

Sun Wukong went up to Dark Vastness Palace to seek the help of the Water Star and the Department of Water after being defeated by the Single Horned Rhinoceros King. The Water Star dropped half the water of the yellow river on Golden Pouch Cave, but the Rhinoceros King used the Diamond Cutter to repel it away from him.
